capabilities: View local events in week, day, month, year, custom-days, and list views with a mini calendar
Store each event as an Event Note with start and end properties linked from its Daily Note
Subscribe to read-only HTTPS or webcal feeds and shade holiday calendars
Render a note's outline as a WBS table or Gantt chart with dates, progress, and assignees
Detect and fix duplicate event_id notes and restore notes with broken properties
disambiguation: The name suggests event-logging notes, but the main artifact is a calendar and Gantt view; the notes are its storage format.
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins directory; installed via ZIP or BRAT and requires desktop Obsidian 1.14.5 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar views, so scheduled events and dated project tasks cannot be browsed by day, week, or timeline inside the vault.
summary: Calendar and Gantt chart plugin that stores events and project tasks as Markdown notes linked from Daily Notes.
